questions.stem: An electron jumps from A $\rightarrow$ C by emitting a wavelength of 2000 Å and also jumps from B $\rightarrow$ C by emitting a wavelength of 6000 Å, then wavelength of that electron; if it jumps from A $\rightarrow$ B
questions.solution:
$\left(\frac{hc}{\lambda}\right)_{AC} = \left(\frac{hc}{\lambda}\right)_{AB} + \left(\frac{hc}{\lambda}\right)_{BC}$
$\left(\frac{1}{\lambda}\right)_{AC} = \left(\frac{1}{\lambda}\right)_{AB} + \left(\frac{1}{\lambda}\right)_{BC}$
$\frac{1}{2000} = \frac{1}{\lambda_{AB}} + \frac{1}{6000}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda_{AB}} = \frac{1}{2000} - \frac{1}{6000}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda_{AB}} = \frac{6000 - 2000}{6000 \times 2000}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda_{AB}} = \frac{4000}{12 \times 10^{6}}$
$\frac{1}{\lambda_{AB}} = \frac{1}{3000}$
$\lambda_{AB} = 3000\ \mathring{\mathrm{A}}$

questions.stem:
Calculate the value of $E^{\circ}_{\mathrm{cell}}$ for given cell based on given information
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + Ag^{+} \rightarrow Fe^{3+} + Ag}$;
$\mathrm{Ag^{+} + e^{-} \rightarrow Ag}$; $E^{\circ} = x\mathrm{V}$
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + 2e^{-} \rightarrow Fe}$; $E^{\circ} = y\mathrm{V}$
$\mathrm{Fe^{3+} + 3e^{-} \rightarrow Fe}$; $E^{\circ} = z\mathrm{V}$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + 2e \rightarrow Fe} \quad E^{o} = y$
$\mathrm{Fe \rightarrow Fe^{3+} + 3e^{-}} \quad E^{o} = -z$
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} \rightarrow Fe^{3+} + e^{-}} \quad E^{o} = w$ (say)
$1 \times w = 2 \times y - 3z$
$w = 2y - 3z$
$\mathrm{Fe^{2+} + Ag^{+} \rightarrow Fe^{3+} + Ag}$
$E^{o}_{\mathrm{Cell}} = E^{o}_{\mathrm{Fe^{2+}/Fe^{3+}}} + E^{o}_{\mathrm{Ag^{+}/Ag}} = 2y - 3z + x$

questions.stem:
$2.32 \times 10^{3}$ kg of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ reacts with $2.8 \times 10^{3}$ kg of CO according to the following reaction :
$\mathrm{Fe_3O_4 + CO \rightarrow CO_2 + Fe}$
If x kg of Fe is formed. Find the value of x?
questions.solution:
Balanced reaction
$\mathrm{Fe_3O_4 + 4CO \rightarrow 4CO_2 + 3Fe}$
Given mass of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4} = 2.32 \times 10^{3}$ kg
Mol. Mass of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ = 232 gm = 0.232 kg
Moles of $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4} = \frac{2.32 \times 10^{3}}{0.232} = 10^{4}$ mol
Given mass of CO = $2.8 \times 10^{3}$ kg
Mol. Mass of CO = 28 gm = 0.028 kg
Moles of CO = $10^{5}$ mol
According to balanced reaction
1 mol $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ requires 4 mol CO
$\therefore$ $10^{4}$ mol $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ requires $4 \times 10^{4}$ mol CO
$\therefore$ CO is in excess
1 mol $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ gives 3 mol Fe
$10^{4}$ mol $\mathrm{Fe_3O_4}$ will gives $3 \times 10^{4}$ mol Fe
$\therefore$ Mass of Fe formed = $3 \times 10^{4} \times \frac{56}{1000}$ = 1680 kg
